duga-home-intro: Duga shows what queer knowledge is missing from Wikimedia projects in your language, and gives you the words and the tools to add it.
duga-home-pick-language: Pick a language to see its overview:
duga-lang-home-placeholder: Gap detection for this language isn't live yet. Check back soon — the first gap lists land in an early milestone.
duga-lang-home-stale: Detector data may be stale (last successful run: $1).
duga-lang-home-no-gaps: No gaps found for this language yet.
duga-gaps-override-success: Saved. This gap won't be shown again.
duga-write-explain-label: $1 has no label in this language yet. Suggest one below.
duga-write-explain-description: $1 has no description in this language yet. Suggest one below.
duga-write-preview-label: You are about to set the $1 label of $2 to: “$3”
duga-write-preview-description: You are about to set the $1 description of $2 to: “$3”
duga-write-preview-public: This edit will be made using your own Wikimedia account and will be public, like any other Wikidata edit.
duga-write-error-disabled: Writing to Wikidata is temporarily disabled. Please try again later.
duga-write-error-rate-limited: Too many edits recently -- please try again in a little while.
duga-write-error-relogin: Your login has expired. Please log in again to continue.
duga-account-attribution-explain: By default, your Wikimedia username is shown next to labels, descriptions, and vocabulary terms you add through Duga, so others know who to thank or ask. Turning this off hides your username from public view; what you added is still recorded internally either way. You can change this at any time, and it applies to everything you've already contributed, not just future contributions.
duga-account-attribution-checkbox: Show my username on my public contributions
duga-oauth-not-configured-body: Duga's Wikimedia login isn't configured on this installation yet. Come back once it is, or check with whoever runs this Duga instance.
duga-oauth-error-body: Something went wrong completing your Wikimedia login. This can happen if the login page was left open too long. No account changes were made.
duga-vocab-add-concept-label: What concept is this a word for?
duga-vocab-add-login-prompt: Log in to add a term
duga-vocab-add-error-required: Please fill in both the concept and the word.
duga-vocab-added-by-anonymous: Added by a contributor who opted out of public attribution.
duga-vocab-evidence-error-required: Please choose a source type and add a citation.
duga-vocab-assert-explain: Let other contributors know whether you've seen this term used this way.
duga-vocab-assert-register-label: What register would you say this term has? (optional)
duga-promote-link-explain-concept: If this concept already has a Wikidata item, link it here. This never creates a new item -- only an existing one can be linked.
duga-promote-link-explain-term: If this term already exists as a Wikidata Lexeme, link it here. This never creates a new lexeme -- only an existing one can be linked.
duga-promote-error-not-local: This can only be proposed while it's still local.
duga-promote-error-not-proposed: This must be proposed before it can be linked to Wikidata.
duga-promote-error-bad-qid: Please enter a valid Wikidata item ID, like Q12345.
duga-promote-error-bad-lexeme: Please enter a valid Wikidata Lexeme ID, like L12345.
duga-promote-error-bad-sense: The Sense ID must belong to the Lexeme ID above, like L12345-S1.
duga-promote-error-qid-taken: That Wikidata item is already linked to a different concept.
duga-promote-error-not-found: That ID doesn't exist on Wikidata. Double-check it and try again.
duga-about-name: "Duga" means rainbow across the Slavic languages, and "to sound the depths" in Indonesian.
duga-about-body: Duga is a multilingual hub that shows what queer knowledge is missing from Wikimedia projects in your language, and gives you the words and the tools to add it.
duga-about-license: Duga is free/open source software, licensed AGPL-3.0.
duga-404-body: That page doesn't exist, or that language isn't set up yet.
